identity.name: TANFAC INDUSTRIES LTD.
identity.industry: Fluorochemicals & Advanced Materials for Energy Transition

summary.oneLiner: TANFAC transformed from a legacy HF producer to India’s sole solar-grade DHF manufacturer with a clear path to HFC-32 dominance, driven by record order books, 65% pre-sold downstream capacity, and aggressive capex — positioning it as the only Indian player with integrated fluorochemical value chain access to high-growth energy transition markets.

one-line thesis: TANFAC transformed from a legacy HF producer to India’s sole solar-grade DHF manufacturer with a clear path to HFC-32 dominance, driven by record order books, 65% pre-sold downstream capacity, and aggressive capex — positioning it as the only Indian player with integrated fluorochemical value chain access to high-growth energy transition markets.
financial scorecard: revenue: +27% YoY to INR711cr (FY26); EBITDA/margin: -13% YoY to INR112cr (16% margin) — impacted by INR7cr higher depreciation, INR30cr Q3 FY25 anomaly, INR2.5-3cr M2M forex loss, INR70cr HF production loss due to unplanned downtime; PAT (rptd): -20% YoY to INR70cr; PAT (normalized): ~INR85cr (excluding one-off depreciation and forex loss); order book: INR1,068cr for solar DHF (3.5y), INR3,612cr in long-term contracts (5-7y), 65% of 20k tpa HFC-32 pre-sold; net debt: net cash position maintained — capex funded via promoter infusion (INR100cr) + QIP + term debt
guidance: revenue growth: 25-30% CAGR over next 3 years; margin: 15-18% range-bound for existing business, >20% expected from HFC-32; order inflow: 80-85% of HFC-32 capacity pre-booked; capex/commissioning: INR495cr for HFC-32 plant (commissioning Q3 FY27), additional 30k tpa HF plant (announcement expected in 2-3 months), 20k tpa solar DHF expansion (targeting June 2027)
order book & pipeline: INR1,068cr for solar grade DHF (executed over 3.5 years); INR3,612cr in long-term supplier agreements (5-7y); 13,000 tpa (65%) of 20k tpa HFC-32 capacity pre-contracted
segment / subsidiary detail: HF: 95% utilization; Sulphuric acid: 101% utilization; Specialty fluorides: 41% utilization (ramping); Solar DHF: 20k tpa capacity, INR15-20/kg premium over industrial HF; HFC-32: 20k tpa under construction, INR240-280/kg production cost, 75-80% export focus
growth verticals / optionality: 20k tpa additional solar DHF capacity (targeting June 2027); 30k tpa HF expansion (to be announced); pipeline in electronic grade fluorinated chemicals, battery electrolytes, high-performance fluoropolymers, inorganic fluorides
margins & cost dynamics: Industrial HF margin: ~INR10-15/kg lower than solar DHF; HFC-32 margin: significantly high (payback <4y); cost pressures: sulphur up from INR30/kg to INR38-40/kg; fluorspar stable; 100% cost pass-through achieved with 30-40 day lag
capex / expansion: INR495cr total for HFC-32 and downstream products (INR405cr for HFC-32, INR90cr for other fluorinated products); additional INR300-400cr planned for HF and solar DHF expansions; funding: INR100cr promoter infusion, INR300cr QIP + term debt
capital allocation: Prioritizing capex for HFC-32 and solar DHF expansions; funding via mix of promoter equity (preferential allotment), QIP, and debt; no dividend payout mentioned — all cash flow reinvested in growth
risks & watch-items: HFC-32 quota allocation uncertainty (though EC secured and government memorandum supports capacity-based allocation); raw material price volatility (sulphur); execution risk on multi-crore capex projects; regulatory delay in quota issuance beyond Jan 2028
management quality / tone: Highly confident, assertive, and strategically focused — repeatedly emphasized execution capability, backward integration, and government support for Atmanirbhar Bharat; dismissed quota concerns by citing public office memorandum; projected 30%+ revenue CAGR with clear visibility
non-obvious takeaways: TANFAC is the only Indian player with integrated HF → solar DHF → HFC-32 chain; 65% pre-sold HFC-32 capacity is unprecedented in Indian chemical sector; HF expansion is not included in INR495cr capex — implying additional INR300-400cr capex is imminent; solar DHF purity <10 PPB is a USFDA-CGMP level barrier to entry; 85% of solar DHF capacity already booked despite only 20k tpa production

scorecard.piotroski_basis: needs 2 FYs of BS_* -> 0 (real from FY27)
scorecard.pe_basis: TTM trailing (spec band written for forward P/E)
